item.title: Version 1.1.1 (build 3)
item.description:
Added

  • In-app uninstall: remove the app, its background helper, and its local data

right from Settings, with a confirmation step first — no separate script

to run.

  • A Privacy section in Settings that spells out exactly what the app reads

and where any of it goes, with a "Learn more" link for the full picture.

  • Friendly placeholders instead of blank panel areas while the app is still

waiting for its first bit of usage data.

Changed

  • Clearer privacy wording throughout, describing precisely what talks to

the network and why.

Fixed

  • Uninstall now cleans up fully, and if a step can't complete, the app tells

you exactly what wasn't removed instead of a generic error.

item.title: Version 1.1.0 (build 2)
item.description:
Added

  • Automatic updates: ClaudeWidget can now keep itself current. It asks for your permission first, then checks for new versions on a standard schedule and installs them in place through the familiar macOS update dialog.
  • Updates section in Settings: check for updates on demand, control automatic checking and downloading (downloads stay off unless you turn them on), and see your current version and when updates were last checked.
